properties.description: The commands, in titled groups; a group with the id "suggestions" gets ⌘1–⌘5

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text in the search field

properties.name: onRun
properties.description: Runs a command (see CommandMenuRun); may return a promise

properties.name: hotkey
properties.description:
Window shortcut that focuses the field: "mod+k" (⌘K on Apple devices, Ctrl K elsewhere), any other combination
like "ctrl+shift+p", or false for none. The most recently connected menu takes it

properties.name: autoFocus
properties.description: Focus the field when the menu appears

properties.name: maxRows
properties.description: Most rows rendered at once – with more matches the menu shows the first ones and asks to keep typing

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-query-change
events.description: The search text changes; detail `{ query }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current text (controlled use)

functions.name: defaultCommandGroups
functions.description: Sample commands – replace with your own

props.name: groups
props.description: The commands, in titled groups; a group with the id "suggestions" gets ⌘1–⌘5. Defaults to the sample `defaultGroups`

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text in the search field

props.name: onRun
props.description: Called with the command id; for the assistant fallback with "ask" and the typed text. May return a promise

props.name: query
props.description: The search text. Controlled when defined; otherwise the menu keeps its own, starting at `defaultQuery`

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The search text to start with when `query` isn't set

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called with the new search text as people type or clear it

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Window shortcut that focuses the field – "mod+k" by default, or false for none

props.name: onClose
props.description: Runs on Esc in an empty search

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the field when the menu appears

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Most rows rendered at once (default 200)
